features.name: Multi-row wins

review:
Donut Division is a doughnut-shop cop slot with Gooey Guns. When a gun lands, it fires Gooey Wilds to the left across its row and then turns into a wild itself. Guns can land with multipliers from 1x to 100x, which every wild on that row shares.

If a winning line passes through gooey rows from several guns, all their multipliers count. Two guns on different rows with decent values can make a very big hit. The maximum is 12,500x. The third-party databases we checked disagree on its RTP, so we haven't listed one.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
